messages.subject: Re: Seeds for Northwest Montana
messages.text:
Hi Michelle,

For Northwest Montana, all our native species will do well, the zone is well within range for everything we carry.

Here's what I'd suggest based on your region:

- Syriaca (Common milkweed): vigorous, spreads readily, great for open areas and roadsides
- Incarnata (Swamp milkweed): more contained, tolerates both dry and wetter soils, easier to manage in a garden setting
- Tuberosa (Butterfly milkweed): stunning orange blooms, prefers well-drained soil, slower to establish but very rewarding
- Speciosa (Showy milkweed): native to the western prairies and a great fit for your region specifically

All four are available here: https://lasclay.com/en/products/milkweed-seeds

We also carry stratified seeds (cold treatment already done, ready to sow): https://lasclay.com/en/products/graines-semences-asclepiade-stratifiees-froid

If you'd like a recommendation based on your specific site (sunny field, garden bed, damp area), let me know and I'll point you to the best fit.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
